scope: Explicit Android4.1.1 notification profile only; Web v5 preserved

outbound.source: AsemanNotificationService.sendMessage instantiates MessangerInput2(raw auth,currentAccount), assigns method and Gson.toJson(payload) to String data, then serializes the model with default Gson
outbound.auth: raw retained auth; no V6 character transformation
outbound.fieldEvidence: MessangerInput2$ClientInfo.packageName has @SerializedName(value='package'); default Gson omits null store/temp_code/data_enc/tmp_session/dataJson. NotificationObject.currentAccount is transient.
outbound.readyMeaning: APK onConnected sends the handshake and marks socket connected immediately. Transport-ready is not a server acknowledgement or a claim of account authentication.
outbound.heartbeat: Web keeps existing JSON {} heartbeat. No invented JSON heartbeat is sent by native mode; bounded existing liveness timeout remains.

inbound.source: AsemanNotificationService$1.onTextMessage -> Gson NotificationObject -> GcmPushListenerService.newNotif -> NotificationObject.makeData -> EncryptionHelper.decryptAuth -> Gson MessengerUpdateObject
inbound.data_enc: AES/CBC/PKCS7PADDING, auth-derived key, static IV and Base64.DEFAULT as the existing native wire profile
inbound.identity: newNotif requires direct MessengerUpdateObject.user_guid equal to account getMyGuid before handleMessengerNotification; native mode therefore requires that direct field and does not assume the Web update_data wrapper
inbound.projection: Only reviewed call_updates and call_signal_data retained; unrelated chats/history/social/notif content never acknowledged or returned by this implementation

ack.source: After newNotif, onTextMessage checks nonempty NotificationObject.ack_id then sendMessage('ack',new AckInputObject(ack_id))
ack.scopeRestriction: This lab sends ACK only after valid same-account call projection, not for unrelated notifications
ack.data: JSON string of {ack_id:<original>}; no encrypted payload, signature or transformed auth
ack.bound: 256 UTF-8 bytes, valid text without controls; last128 ACK IDs plus hashes of projected call data retained privately. Exact duplicate data re-ACKed without duplicate queueing; reused ID with changed valid data is retained.
ack.privacy: No ACK IDs, auth, decrypted unrelated content or call data logged/exposed in public state
